evals.prompt: I need to grab a product image from Pexels for my store. Download https://images.pexels.com/photos/90946/pexels-photo-90946.jpeg and convert it to WebP at thumb, medium, and large sizes. Save them to public/images with the name 'coffee-shop'.
evals.expected_output: Three WebP files created in public/images: coffee-shop-thumb.webp (150x150), coffee-shop-medium.webp (600x600), coffee-shop-large.webp (1200xauto). Each file should exist and be valid WebP.

assertions.name: large_width_is_1200
assertions.description: Large size has width of 1200px with auto height

assertions.name: naming_with_presets
assertions.description: Files named with size preset suffixes

assertions.name: files_are_webp
assertions.description: All files are valid WebP format

evals.prompt: I have a local image at /tmp/sample-product.jpg that I need resized to 400x400 and converted to WebP for my product listing page. Put it in public/images.
evals.expected_output: A WebP file created in public/images named sample-product-400x400.webp at exactly 400x400 pixels. The file should be valid WebP format.

assertions.name: filename_includes_dimensions
assertions.description: Filename includes the custom dimension suffix

evals.prompt: Download https://images.pexels.com/photos/414612/pexels-photo-414612.jpeg and generate thumb, small, medium, and large sizes as WebP so I can use them in a responsive image srcset. Name them 'mountain-lake'.
evals.expected_output: Four WebP files in public/images: mountain-lake-thumb.webp (150x150), mountain-lake-small.webp (300x300), mountain-lake-medium.webp (600x600), mountain-lake-large.webp (1200xauto). Plus HTML srcset usage guidance.

assertions.name: large_width_is_1200
assertions.description: Large has width of 1200px with auto height

assertions.name: correct_preset_naming
assertions.description: Files named with size preset suffixes

assertions.name: provides_srcset_guidance
assertions.description: Output includes responsive image usage guidance
